name: Euler Finance
summary: Euler's EToken donateToReserves path skipped the liquidity check, enabling discounted self-liquidation. The implicated EToken module was activated in Euler's module router on 2022-08-18. Later installs of unrelated modules do not reset the age of this defect-bearing artifact.
notes: InstallerInstallModule activated moduleId 500000 at the EToken implementation containing donateToReserves.
Approximate gross multi-asset value reported by Euler; subsequent recovery is not netted from exploit-time loss.
Euler reports the gross loss as approximately $197 million across several assets.
